reasoning: As of December 4, 2024, Yoon declared martial law on December 3 and lifted it within hours after the National Assembly voted to block it. The opposition Democratic Party was moving to impeach him, with a vote expected around December 7. The Constitutional Court then needs six of nine justices to uphold, and it has up to 180 days to decide. Park Geun-hye's case took about three months from impeachment to ruling, so a decision by March 31 is possible but not assured, and upholding is likely but not certain. Yoon has also said he will not resign, which makes a voluntary exit unlikely. Combining these steps gives roughly a one-in-four chance of YES.
